text: A Bell state is maximally entangled: tracing out one qubit leaves the maximally mixed state (identity over 2), and the state carries exactly one ___ (unit) of entanglement entropy.
explanation: A maximally entangled two-qubit (Bell) state contains one ebit; equivalently its reduced density matrix is identity/2 with entanglement entropy S = 1 bit. The ebit is the standard unit of bipartite pure-state entanglement.
